name: Vertebrate-L Tryptamine Macrobicycle
description: Non-Abelian braided tryptamine cage — Ω=𐑟 realized via macrocyclic chiral bridge
rationale: Ω=𐑟 (non-Abelian winding) requires topological braiding in 3D. A macrocyclic tryptamine with chiral bridgehead C-atoms creates non-commuting ring closure paths. T=𐑥 (bowtie network) realized by fused indole-piperidine-benzene crossing. H=𐑫 (eternal chirality) via 3 stereocenters in the cage.
